name: Alarm Tap
description: While an alarm rings, a black screen shows the time, the snooze count and a hint. A tap or a hardware key snoozes, a double tap or a second key press stops. Counts and limits snoozes and can speak a text for each step. Needs the Clock or Weather Mood screensaver with Let alarms take over: KS's own alarm screen covers plugin overlays.
author: d3rb3rt

settings.title: Alarm ringing entity
settings.description: A binary sensor that is on while the alarm rings, such as the kiosk's Alarm ringing sensor.

settings.title: Snooze label
settings.description: The big text on the ringing screen. Empty: the built-in text in the chosen language.

settings.title: Show the time
settings.description: Shows the current time above the snooze label.

settings.title: Tap action
settings.description: Runs on a single tap while the alarm rings, for example a script that snoozes.

settings.title: Double tap action
settings.description: Runs on a double tap while the alarm rings, for example a script that stops it.

settings.title: Snooze length
settings.description: One snooze as set in KS. Used for {total} and {length} and to know how long the alarm stays snoozed.

settings.title: Maximum snoozes
settings.description: 0 means unlimited. Once this many snoozes are used, a tap runs the limit action instead of the tap action.

settings.title: New alarm after
settings.description: The count starts again when the alarm rings after a pause longer than this.

settings.title: Double tap window
settings.description: A single tap runs after this wait, unless a second tap follows within it.

settings.title: Snooze keys
settings.description: Keys that snooze while the alarm rings (Android names without KEYCODE_, comma-separated). A key also listed under Stop keys stops on a quick second press. Empty: no key snoozes.

settings.title: Stop keys
settings.description: Keys that stop the alarm, also while it is snoozed. Empty: no key stops. Turn on KS's option to swallow the volume keys if they should not change the volume.

settings.title: Second key press window
settings.description: A second press of a snooze and stop key within this time stops the alarm. A snooze-only key ignores it.

settings.title: Hint text
settings.description: Shown below the snooze label while the alarm rings. Empty: the built-in text in the chosen language. A single - means no hint.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the built-in texts. Auto follows the device (German or English, otherwise English). Texts you type are used as they are.

settings.title: Speak service
settings.description: Action that speaks, as domain.action. Empty: no speech. This kiosk's own: Developer tools > Actions in Home Assistant, type announce, take the name of this kiosk's entry, e.g. esphome.bedroom_clock_announce. See the README.

settings.title: Extra service data (JSON)
settings.description: More fields for the action, as JSON; the text goes as "message". Empty fits the kiosk announce action. For tts.speak e.g. {"entity_id": "tts.x", "media_player_entity_id": "media_player.y"}.

settings.title: Text on tap
settings.description: Spoken on snooze. Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of the snooze announcement
settings.description: Only for a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume (0 to 1). 0 sends none. Other services play at the speaker's volume.

settings.title: Text on double tap
settings.description: Spoken when the alarm stops. Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of the end of alarm announcement
settings.description: Only for a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume (0 to 1). 0 sends none. Other services play at the speaker's volume.

settings.title: Text at the limit
settings.description: Spoken when the maximum is reached. Empty: built-in text. - : silence. Placeholders: {n} this snooze, {total} snooze minutes so far, {length} one snooze, {max} the limit.

settings.title: Volume of the limit announcement
settings.description: Only for a kiosk announce action, sent as its volume (0 to 1). 0 sends none. Other services play at the speaker's volume.
